Havering Residents Association is OFFICIAL OPPOSITION with 14 seats (NOT Labour).
London boroughs have NO Fire Authority appointments + NO PCC panel — fewer external-SRA outside bodies than mets.
Keith Prince AM brings ex-Leader of Redbridge + sitting London Assembly seat — unusual political weight.
